CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  (Notice No. N2M20-38)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a special meeting of the Alhambra Design Review Board will be
held on Tuesday, April 14, 2020, commencing at 4:30 p.m., to consider those items listed on the
attached agenda pursuant to the order of the Chairman of the City of Alhambra Design Review
Board, the Alhambra City Charter, the Alhambra Municipal Code, and Section 54956 of the
Government Code of the State of California.

Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-25-20, No. N-29-20, and No. N-35-20 from the Executive
Department of the State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health
Safer At Home Order, the Alhambra Design Review Board meeting will not be physically open
to the public and all Board Members will be teleconferencing into the meeting via
teleconference.

An agenda of such special meeting is attached hereto incorporated herein by reference and made a
part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  CHRISTINE OLSON
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD CHAIRMAN

Dated:  April 9, 2020
Notice No.  N2M20-38

  2
   ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  April 14, 2020
  AGENDA
  111 South First Street
  April 14, 2020
  4:30 p.m.

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-25-20, No. N-29-20, and No. N-35-20 from the Executive
Department of the State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health
Safer At Home Order, the Alhambra Design Review Board meeting will not be physically open to
the public and all Board Members will be teleconferencing into the meeting via teleconference.

To listen to the meeting telephonically: To maximize public safety while still maintaining
transparency and public access, members of the public can participate by dialing into the meeting
by calling 978-990-5000 and entering access code 448112 when prompted. Note that all members
of the public calling into the meeting will be muted so that the meeting can proceed.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please email David Tran at
dtran@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with your name and the phone number you will be
using to call into the meeting. You should then call into the meeting using the number above at
least 10 minutes prior to its start time. Mr. Tran will unmute your phone line and announce you
when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by
the meeting chair.

As an alternative you can email your comments by sending them to the Planning Division by email
at plam@cityofalhambra.org no later than 3:30 p.m. to ensure that Planning Staff has time to print
the emails prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with
a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the Chairperson’s
discretion. If a comment is received after 3:30 p.m. but before the conclusion of the meeting based
upon its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but
will not be read into the record.

Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated
should email or call the Community Development Department at plam@cityofalhambra.org or
(626) 570-5034 who will use their best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide
as much accessibility as possible while also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of
telephonic meetings, all participants are encouraged to email their comments prior to the
beginning of the meeting.

   ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD

  AGENDA

CALL MEETING TO ORDER:

ROLL CALL:
CHRISTINE OLSON, President
STEVEN CHEN, Member
KATIE CHIU, Member
ANKIT UDANI, Member
RICHARD ABE, Secretary

ELECTION OF OFFICERS:

The Design Review Board shall hold an election for Board Member positions for President,
Vice President and Secretary.

CONSENT CALENDAR (Item 1):

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to be
routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration. Items
placed under Consent Calendar include smaller scale projects with no or minor design
issues and ministerial matters (minutes).

1.  1237 East Main Street
This is an application for new signage to an existing commercial building for the busines
known as “Davita Kidney Care.”
Applicant: Superior Electrical Advertising

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approved as submitted.

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

2.  1903 South Meridian Avenue
This is an application for replacing an existing backyard fence of a single-family residence.

  1
 Applicant: Thang Nyuyen

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the condition
that the approval is contingent upon approval of the Modification application by the
Community Development Director.

3.  3000 West Valley Boulevard
This is an application for an amendment to a Uniform Sign Program to an existing multi-
tenant commercial building.
Applicant: Ruby Goldenberg

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the following
conditions: 1. The Design Standards shall note that each tenant's primary and secondary
signs shall be consistent in style; 2. The sign details shall refer to the elevation drawings
for sign locations; 3. The elevation drawings shall include dimensions and/or notes for
locations of each sign; and 4. The drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff
prior to permit issuance.

4.  1621 West Shorb Street
This is an application for window replacements to an existing single-family residence.
Applicant: Dolores Aguilar

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the following
conditions: 1. Hung windows shall be used throughout; 2. Window details shall be
consistent throughout; 3. The bedroom patio door shall be specified as such; 4. Revised
drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.

5.  121 East Main Street
This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing commercial building.
Applicant: Vincent Huen

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the following
conditions: 1. The paint colors shall be restudied as it relates to the overall facade shared
by the adjacent nail salon; 2. Any revised colors shall be updated in the drawings and
reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.

6.  2499 West Main Street
This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing hotel.
Applicant: John Jae Y Chung

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the following
conditions: 1. The proposed paint colors shall be used consistently throughout the
building; 2. The drawings shall be updated or corrected to address the new stonework
shown on the rear elevation; 3. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB

  2
 staff prior to permit issuance.

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
Citizens wishing to address the Alhambra Design Review Board on any matter within the
subject matter jurisdiction of the Alhambra Design Review Board not on the Agenda may
do so at this time. Please STATE YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS CLEARLY for the record.

Please note that while the Alhambra Design Review Board values your comments, pursuant
to January 1, 1987 amendments of the Brown Act, the Commission cannot respond nor take
any action until such time as the matter may appear as an item on a forthcoming agenda.

ADJOURNMENT:

NOTICE:
AGENDA ITEMS: Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each
item of business described hereinabove are on file in the offices of the Community
Development Department in City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California, and are
available for public inspection during regular office hours, which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any of the above
agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, he or she may contact the Community
Development Director either in person at the Department offices, or by telephone at (626)
570-5034 during regular office hours.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT: If you require special assistance to participate in any
City meeting (including assisted listening devices) please contact the Community
Development Department at (626) 570-5034. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the
meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
meeting.

APPEALS: Any person wishing to appeal any decision of the Design Review Board to the
Planning Commission may do so by filing an appeal in writing along with the appropriate
appeal fee to the Community Development Department in City Hall within 10 calendar days
of the Design Review Board decision. The appeal period for items on this agenda expires at
the close of business on April 27, 2020.

ADDRESS: 1237 East Main Street
APPLICANT: Superior Electrical Advertising
BUSINESS TENANT: Davita Kidney Care
PROPERTY OWNER: Jinbo Holdings LLC
PROJECT TYPE: This is an application for new signage to an existing commercial building
fo th business known as “Davita Kidney Care.”
PROJECT STATUS: First Time Applicant

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application proposes new signage to an existing commercial
building for a business known as "Davita Kidney Care." The design consists of two lines of
copy using internally illuminated channel letters for the upper line of copy and plastic
surface mounted letters for the secondary line. The two new building signs are located at
the south (front) and west elevations and are the same in size. They use a design that is
consistent with the recognized national brand which is blue in color. The other signs
proposed are vinyl door signs for directional purposes. The main entrance door uses a
white vinyl and the remaining directional vinyl signs are black. Sizes and designs are
acceptable.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approved as submitted.

PROJECT TYPE: This is an application for replacing an existing backyard fence of a single-
family residence.
PROJECT STATUS: First Time Applicant

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application proposes to replace the existing backyard fence
of an existing single-family residence. This property is located on a steep upslope through
lot with the rear yard facing Grandview Drive. The existing rear fence is a rusted chainlink
fence and will be replaced with a 5'-4" high horizontal plank white vinyl fence. The fence
will also include a man gate where the existing stairs are located. Although the existing
and proposed fences enclose the portion of the property that functions as the backyard,
the through lot condition requires that this area be treated similar to a front yard and that
any fencing is limited to a maximum height of 3’-0”. A Modification application for a taller
fence has been submitted and is subject to review and approval by the Community
Development Director. The proposed design is accpetable for the location of this fence.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval with condition that the approval
is contingent upon approval of the Modification application by the Community
Development Director.

be acceptable. Consideration should be made to including a note that states each tenant's
primary and secondary signs shall match. Locations of the signs shall be referred to the
elevation drawings as the secondary sign of Tenant B is not centered on the tenants lease
space on that elevation. Dimensions and/or notes shall be added on the elevations.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions:

  sign; and

ADDRESS: 121 East Main Street

BUSINESS TENANT: Rev Watches
PROPERTY OWNER: 121 East Main Street LLC
PROJECT TYPE: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing commercial
building.
PROJECT STATUS: First Time Applicant

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application proposes exterior alterations to an existing
commercial building for the business known as "Rev Watches." Alterations consist of
extending the entrance towards the street, adding a new frameless glass storefront
system and restoring the existing metal canopy to accomodate a new sign. The proposed
elevations show a sign that covers the front of the canopy however signage will be
submitted under a separate application and should not be reviewed at this time. The new
storefront system does not include a transom condition and will extend the header over
the entrance area. Although the new color palette for this tenant space is acceptable,
consideration and clarification should be made as to where the new paint starts and stops
as it relates to the adjacent nail salon. Despite the fact that thee two businesses are
located on separate properties, the two spaces share an overall façade. Consideration
should be made for using complimentary colors.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions:

  1. The paint colors shall be restudied as it relates to the overall facade shared by the
  adjacent nail salon; and
  2. Any revised colors shall be updated in the drawings and reviewed and approved
  by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.

DESIGN ASSESSMENT: This application proposes exterior alterations to an existing
commercial building known as "GreenTree Inn & Suites." The alterations consist of
repainting the building with a lighter more neutral color palette. Due to the inconsistent
use of the paint colors throughout the building the applicant should clarify their design
intention. The rear elevation shows stonework being added to the first floor which should
be noted on the drawings to match existing, if accurate. As with all projects with
substantial exterior alterations, painting of the entire building is assumed.

RECOMMENDATION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions:

  1. The proposed paint colors shall be used consistently throughout the building;
  2. The drawings shall be updated or corrected to address the new stonework shown
  on the rear elevation; and
  3. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit
  issuance.
